passive.name: Departing Anew
passive.text: After the wearer uses Skill or Ultimate on one ally character, the wearer regenerates **6/6.5/7/7.5/8** Energy and the ability's target receives 1 stack of "Hymn" for **3** turn(s), stacking up to **3** time(s). Each stack of "Hymn" increases its holder's DMG dealt by **15/17.25/19.5/21.75/24%**. After every **2** instance(s) of Skill or Ultimate the wearer uses on one ally character, recovers 1 Skill Point.

passive.name: Cannot Stop It!
passive.text: When the wearer uses their Ultimate, all allies' actions are Advanced Forward by **16/18/20/22/24%**.

passive.name: Fleet Triumph
passive.text: After the wearer uses attacks or gets hit, additionally regenerates **4/5/6/7/8** Energy. This effect cannot be repeatedly triggered in a single turn.

passive.name: Heir
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by **10/12/14/16/18%** and regenerates 1 Skill Point when the wearer uses their Ultimate on an ally. This effect can be triggered once after every 2 uses of the wearer's Ultimate. When the wearer uses their Skill, the next ally taking action (except the wearer) deals **30/35/40/45/50%** more DMG for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: Departure
passive.text: After entering battle, if an ally deals the same DMG Type as the wearer, DMG dealt increases by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

substatLine: SPD (Until Breakpoint) = ATK% (Until Recommended) > HP = DEF > EFF RES%
tracePriority: Jubilant Passage (A6) > Nourished Joviality (A2) > Knell Subdual (A4)

entries.name: Dislodged
entries.text: Tingyun deals Lightning DMG equal to **100%** of her ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Soothing Melody
entries.text:
Grants a single ally with Benediction to increase their ATK by **50%**, up to **25%** of Tingyun's current ATK.
When the ally with Benediction attacks, they will deal Lightning Additional DMG equal to **40%** of that ally's ATK for 1 time.
Benediction lasts for **3** turn(s) and is only effective on the most recent receiver of Tingyun's Skill.

entries.name: Amidst the Rejoicing Clouds
entries.text: Regenerates **50** Energy for a single ally and increases the target's DMG by **50%** for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Violet Sparknado
entries.text: When an enemy is attacked by Tingyun, the ally with Benediction immediately deals Lightning Additional DMG equal to **60%** of that ally's ATK to the same enemy.

entries.name: Gentle Breeze
entries.text: Tingyun immediately regenerates **50** Energy upon using her Technique.

entries.name: Nourished Joviality
entries.text: Tingyun's SPD increases by **20%** for 1 turn after using Skill.

entries.name: Knell Subdual
entries.text: DMG dealt by Basic ATK increases by **40%**.

entries.name: Jubilant Passage
entries.text: Tingyun immediately regenerates **5** Energy at the start of her turn.

entries.name: Windfall of Lucky Springs
entries.text: After using their Ultimate, the ally with Benediction gains a 20% increase in SPD for 1 turn.

entries.name: Gainfully Gives, Givingly Gains
entries.text: The ally with Benediction regenerates 5 Energy after defeating an enemy. This effect can only be triggered once per turn.

entries.name: Halcyon Bequest
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Jovial Versatility
entries.text: The DMG multiplier provided by Benediction increases by 20%.

entries.name: Sauntering Coquette
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Peace Brings Wealth to All
entries.text: Ultimate regenerates 10 more Energy for the target ally.
